name: Wenneker Jonge Jenever
history: 1693 | Hendrick Steeman licensed to set up two distilling kettles (16 Feb 1693)
1903 | Sold to Johannes Cornelis van der Tuijn, a Schiedam maltster
1967 | Company moves from Schiedam to Roosendaal
notes: No product-level source found for the Jonge Jenever. Backlog says Schiedam; distillery has been in Roosendaal since 1967. Wenneker also owns the Olifant genever brand (via J.J. Melchers).
